data.title: 鸢一折纸 · AST 休假海滩的测风
data.description: 【海滨训练基地·晴日】折纸穿着蓝白运动泳装坐在浮标旁，认真记录风速，却被飞来的海鸥叼走了纸角；她追到浅水边，白发被海风吹乱，最后面无表情地举起找回的记录本。
data.action: 浮标旁记录风速被海鸥抢纸，追入浅水后举起找回的记录本
data.lighting: hard blue daylight softened by sea haze
data.promptProse: Origami Tobiichi from Date A Live wears a navy-and-white athletic swimsuit with a light windbreaker tied at the waist and waterproof sandals. She sits beside a bright orange buoy with a waterproof notebook balanced on her knee, treating the holiday wind like a measured operation. A gull steals one corner of the page, sending her into the shallows; she returns with wind-tossed hair and the recovered note held up in quiet triumph. hard blue daylight softened by sea haze.
